Interpolate built layer data between animation states

Source: R/tween-3d.R
tween_3d.Rd

Adds n in-between frames to each adjacent pair of states. Statistics run on each state before interpolation. Positions interpolate in transformed scale units; colours interpolate in linear light. The scales are trained on all states. Use an explicit group aesthetic for persistent identities.

Usage

tween_3d(
  n = 10L,
  ease = "linear",
  match = "group",
  enter = "fade",
  exit = "fade"
)

Arguments

n

Number of in-between frames per adjacent state pair.

ease

An easing name accepted by camera_path_3d(), or a function taking and returning numeric fractions between zero and one.

match

"group" matches marks by their group values and then by occurrence within a group, as in gganimate's transition_states(). ".source" matches the source row numbers within each state.

enter, exit

"fade" fades unmatched geometry, "keep" shows it throughout the transition, or a function returning an altered data frame with the same rows and columns. An enter function supplies starting attributes; an exit function supplies ending attributes.

Value

A tween specification for animate_3d().

Details

Paths and polygon rings are resampled by three-dimensional arc length when their vertex counts differ. Polygon reading order is aligned by ring winding and the nearest start vertex. Fixed-topology surfaces and meshes match their face/corner keys; changes of mesh connectivity cross-fade the two shapes. Rotations use quaternion interpolation.

References

gganimate, transition_states(); transformr, tween_polygon().

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(0, 1, 1, 2), y = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
                z = c(0, 1, 2, 0), id = c("a", "b", "a", "b"), t = c(0, 0, 1, 1))
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, group = id)) +
  geom_point_3d() + coord_3d()
if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
  animation <- animate_3d(p, time = "t", tween = tween_3d(n = 2),
    width = 320, height = 320, progress = FALSE)
  unlink(animation$frames)
}
